errors.what: Ran node --test on server.test.mjs with a failing assertion before the fix; the assertion skipped s.close(), so the open HTTP server kept the suite alive past the 120 s tool limit and it had to be killed.

doc_friction.issue: Step 0 asks to fix every open defect first, but all 9 are control-plane and 6 already sit in owner-approval PRs; the open list does not show which already have a PR, so each run re-checks by hand. redteam.py open could print a linked PR if the record had one.
The pkill hook rejects `pkill -f '[n]ode ...'` when 'node' appears anywhere else in the same command line (here a later `node --test`), which the CLAUDE.md hint about bracketing does not mention.

notes: Campaign: admin.mjs 0/8 caught; 3 equivalent (CSS), 5 gaps closed by admin.test.mjs (fake DOM + stubbed fetch), rerun 5/5 caught_after_fix. Hunt found formatMoney zero-decimal lists short in dunning-engine (10/16), trial-converter (7/16), cancel-flow (4/16): 5000 XPF rendered 'CFPF 50'. All fixed with failing-first tests (verified failing on the stashed old code). Dashboard dropped atRiskMinor (object); summary now returns atRisk string. Guard added: platform/ci/check_stripe_zero_decimal.py + test_check_stripe_zero_decimal.py; first run on the pre-fix tree flagged all 3 lists, fixed tree clean; an earlier version without the all-codes rule false-flagged a receipt symbol map and the Facturae XSD currency enumeration, tightened. Runs via unwired_checks.py (listed by --list). Local: dunning-engine 107/107, cancel-flow 63/63, trial-converter 40/40 node tests pass; guard unittest 5 OK.

real_defects.issue: formatMoney's zero-decimal list lacked 7 of Stripe's 16 (BIF, DJF, GNF, KMF, MGA, VUV, XPF): a 5000 XPF invoice was emailed to the customer as 'CFPF 50', 100x too small (reproduced with node -e). Fixed with the full list; test over all 16.
Same bug, 7-code list (missing BIF, DJF, GNF, KMF, MGA, PYG, RWF, VUV, XPF). Fixed; test added (failed before the fix).
Same bug, 4-code list (jpy, krw, vnd, clp only): retention-offer amounts in 12 currencies shown 100x too small. Fixed; test added (failed before the fix).

The /admin dashboard filters out object fields of /v1/summary, so atRiskMinor ({usd: 400}), the money still at risk, never showed. summary() now also returns atRisk, a formatted string ('$4.00 + ...'), which the cards show; server.test asserts it.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
